[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested focusing on toss consistency, shoulder rotation, racquet head speed, follow-through, practicing with purpose, analyzing the serve, mixing up serves, strengthening core and legs, practicing under pressure, and seeking feedback from a coach.
